entries.rationale: The pinned client Changed method validates only payload UTF-8 length and non-nullness, then sets pending. Both empty string and {} satisfy that same bound; Changed never parses their contents.

After disposal, invalidation without its guard only changes private generation and pending and writes latest=null again. Disposed is permanent and dominates all refresh/queue guards, so no projected state or public work can change. No external calls occur in Invalidate.

Generation is an equality-only token. Decrementing instead of incrementing creates the same distinct active epochs with the same 64-bit wrap period. Dispose also changes generation, but disposed is independently checked first and permanently prevents acceptance.
The disposal generation update is redundant to the permanent disposed flag. Refresh completion rejects disposed before comparing generation, and every future refresh request is rejected at entry.
Direction of the disposal generation update is unobservable: disposed is already permanently true and independently rejects every pending or future refresh before epoch equality matters.
